cases.name: Michelle Marie Hayes
cases.narrative:
On 8/03/1985, several neighbors discovered her decaying body in a shallow grave in a berry patch at 7059 Hopkins Rd in Mentor, OH. Michelle's legs were cut off just below the torso. 

"It wasn't some stranger that she knew, and she went to Cohen's house,” said (her sister Dawn) Hayes. "After she rejected his sexual advances, he hit her in the throat, and they decided to cut her legs off with a handsaw and put her body in the neighbor's berry patch." 

Scott Grant told police while he was "having intercourse" (he was charged with rape) with Michelle at his residence, she got angry at the presence of Steve Cohen and yelled at appellant to stop whereupon he had punched her in the throat "so that she would shut up." He further detailed how he and Steve, believing her dead, had cut off her legs just below the torso with a conventional cross cut saw and buried her torso and legs in a shallow grave in the berry patch behind their residence.

cases.name: Kristen Marie Laux
cases.about: Her obituary said, "She will always be remembered for her beautiful smile and loving soul and will be deeply missed by all who knew her."
